verses.text: This is a message about Nineveh. It is the book of the vision of Nahum from Elkosh.
The LORD is a jealous God who punishes. The LORD punishes and is full of anger. The LORD takes revenge on his enemies and stays angry with those who oppose him.
The LORD is slow to become angry, but his power is great. He will never let the guilty go unpunished. He makes his way through the whirlwind and the storm, and the clouds are the dust under his feet.
He commands the sea, and it dries up. He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flowers of Lebanon fade.
The mountains shake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, the world and everyone who lives in it.
Who can stand up to his anger? Who can survive his fierce fury? His anger pours out like fire, and the rocks are shattered before him.
The LORD is good, a safe place in times of trouble. He cares for those who run to him for safety.
But with a flood of rushing water he will completely destroy Nineveh. He will chase his enemies into darkness.
Why do you plot against the LORD? He will completely destroy you. Trouble will not need to come a second time.
They are tangled together like thorns and drunk with their wine. They will be burned up completely like dry straw.
From you, Nineveh, has come one who plots evil against the LORD and gives wicked advice.
This is what the LORD says: "Even though they are strong and many, they will be cut down and disappear. Judah, though I have made you suffer, I will not make you suffer anymore.
Now I will break their yoke off your neck and tear your chains away."

The LORD has given this command about you, king of Nineveh: "You will have no descendants to carry on your name. I will destroy the carved idols and metal images in the temple of your gods. I will prepare your grave, because you are worthless."

Look! On the mountains comes the messenger who brings good news, who announces peace! Celebrate your festivals, Judah, and keep your promises. The wicked will never invade you again. They will be completely destroyed.
